verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents authorization controls to specify rules on how/where issued cards may be used, plus a dedicated Spend product with card expense tracking, and marketing materials explicitly tout 'Spend Controls' for corporate cards, together covering per-card limits and granular employee-level controls. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the granularity (e.g., per-employee limit UI walkthrough) beyond docs and marketing copy.
